Dragon's Lair.name: Dragon's Lair
Dragon's Lair.summary: Haven't heard of Dragon's Lair?! Well, you play the heroic Dirk the Daring, a valiant knight on a quest to rescue the fair princess from the clutches of an evil dragon! Originally released in the summer of 1983, Dragon's Lair has solidified itself as a cultural icon in gaming.

Fun 'n Games.name: Fun 'N Games
Fun 'n Games.summary: A compilation of games and "applications" aimed at children for the Genesis, Super Nintendo and 3DO.
